dialogues.en:
I muttered to cheer myself up, but my words were sadly
sucked into the room.
dialogues.text:
I muttered to cheer myself up, but my words were sadly
sucked into the room.

dialogues.jp: カップ麺を｛すす／啜｝りながら、独りテレビを観る。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai went back home yesterday evening with the moving
company.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai went back home yesterday evening with the moving
company.

dialogues.en:
They packed her stuff in the blink of an eye, and loaded it
into the truck in no time.
dialogues.text:
They packed her stuff in the blink of an eye, and loaded it
into the truck in no time.

dialogues.jp:
気分を盛り上げるために呟いた言葉が、虚しく
居間の空気に吸い込まれる。
dialogues.en:
I saw her off as she bowed at me, and I've been absentminded
since then.
dialogues.text:
I saw her off as she bowed at me, and I've been absentminded
since then.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩は今日の夕方、荷物をとりに来た引越し
業者とともに自宅に帰っていった。
dialogues.en: "I should've asked her to stay here......"
dialogues.text: "I should've asked her to stay here......"

dialogues.jp:
あれよあれよという間に箱詰めされ、トラック
に収められていくさまは、さすがプロといった
鮮やかさだった。
dialogues.en: However we're too young to be living together for no reason.
dialogues.text: However we're too young to be living together for no reason.

dialogues.jp:
ペコペコと挨拶をする萌先輩を見送り、ぼんや
りとした時間が今に続いている。
「やっぱ呼び止めればよかったかな……」
dialogues.en: I think I'll be lazy from tomorrow on.......
dialogues.text: I think I'll be lazy from tomorrow on.......

dialogues.jp:
でも理由もなく同棲生活を続けるのは、まだ俺
たちには荷が重過ぎる。
dialogues.en:
I finished my noodles and thought about my not-so-exciting
future......
dialogues.text:
I finished my noodles and thought about my not-so-exciting
future......

dialogues.jp:
一人、カップ麺を｛すす／啜｝りながら思い出す。夕方、
萌先輩はえらく手際の良い引越し業者とともに、
割とあっさりと去っていった。
dialogues.en: I watched TV by myself while eating instant noodles.
dialogues.text: I watched TV by myself while eating instant noodles.

dialogues.jp:
ペコペコと挨拶していたのは、萌先輩らしかっ
たけど。
